name: postgres-mcp
description: Connect Claude to your PostgreSQL database for querying, analysis, and schema exploration. Despite the generic warning, this extension ONLY connects to your database — it does not access your filesystem.

host.title: Database Host
host.description: The hostname or IP address of your PostgreSQL server (e.g. localhost or db.example.com)

port.title: Database Port
port.description: The port number for your PostgreSQL server

database.title: Database Name
database.description: The name of the database to connect to

access_mode.title: Access Mode
access_mode.description: Use 'restricted' for read-only access (recommended for production), or 'unrestricted' for full read/write access

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in a schema

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Get column details for a table

tools.name: explain_query
tools.description: Get the execution plan for a query

tools.name: analyze_table_indexes
tools.description: Analyze index usage for a table

tools.name: suggest_indexes
tools.description: Get index recommendations for a query
